title: Active restriction of the parity target
statement: Let $m\ge 7$, and let $y$ be a sign vector of length $2m^2$. Form an input of length $2^m$ by placing the coordinates of $y$ on the active coordinates, in the specified reindexing, and assigning $+1$ to every inactive coordinate. The target function on this input equals the sign-valued mod-two inner-product function on the two length-$m^2$ blocks of $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a natural number with $7\le m$
